The novel TBC1D8B variant in a 6-Month-Old Boy with Steroid-Sensitive Nephrotic Syndrome: a Case Report

Genetic testing revealed a maternally inherited novel hemizygous variant, NM_017752 : c.628 A > T, p.Lys210Ter, in TBC1D8B . ... in vitro functional experiments showed that this variant may lead to TBC1D8B protein degradation. IF results showed disrupted interaction with RAB11A/RAB11B, that then affects the biological function of RAB proteins in the process of cell intimal vesicle formation and intracellular transport.
